title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode11 Retirement

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
All right, that's good for today.
You're really starting to improve.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you!
I have you and Hinomori to thank for everything!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Minori, have you seen Shizuku at all lately?
I think she's been really busy with work. I haven't seen her at school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I think she was here earlier this afternoon.
One of my friends is a fan and said she saw her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What? R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. Is something wrong, Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
.....
I kinda said something really terrible to her the other day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She was worried about me, and I told her that everyone praises her as an idol without her barely having to do a thing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I want to apologize to her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Why would you say something like that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think it's because I'm actually jealous of her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We worked for the same agency, but Shizuku's always had so many of the things I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was really surprised the first time I met her. Of course her looks were part of it, but she just had this quality about her. You couldn't help but look her way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was like she was born to be an idol. I felt totally defeated. I still promised myself I wouldn't lose, of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We both worked hard together until our debut.
It was tough, but we helped each other get through it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then I started getting treated less and less like an idol, while Shizuku's career kept moving further ahead.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I kept thinking that if only I could be more like her... Oh, I'm such a terrible person...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Momoi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's go find her so you can apologize, then!
What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's check the classroom first, then—hm?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What's this? A notification from my news app?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Momoi, this is terrible! Look!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: That's it for classroom duty today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Momoi? Why is she in such a hurry?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... Oh, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You look flustered, too. What happened?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I just heard the news...

rows.Speaker: Breaking News:
rows.Line: <We have just learned that Shizuku Hinomori, lead of the popular group known as Cheerful*Days, has withdrawn from the group and left her agency.>
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Stop right there, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So the rumors that you were planning on leaving Cheerful*Days were true? But why?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Why won't you say something?!
Tell me the truth, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hinomori! Is it really true that you quit?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They told me they were going to wait a little longer before announcing it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then it's true?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why, though?! There's absolutely no reason for you to quit being an idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're so good that anybody would be jealous! You're beautiful and you have an aura about you that makes people turn your way just by standing there!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why do you have to say that?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: ...What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You were the one who taught me that having heart was the most important thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That an idol is someone who gives hope to their fans.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I've tried so hard all this time to become that kind of idol. But now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But now everyone attacks me, talking about my looks or how I was born to be an idol and don't have to work for it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Did you quit because of me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because of what I said?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've...been thinking about quitting for a while now. Ever since things started falling apart with the others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The others? You mean the other members of Cheerful*Days?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that mean the rumors of them being jealous of you were true?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It wasn't like that at first.
We used to have fun competing and pushing each other to work harder.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everything changed once I started being the center. It began to seem like the selection process for choosing the center was just formality.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It seemed like no matter how hard the others worked, I was the only one getting more job offers.
They started to grow distant.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I tried to smooth things over so we could keep working together, but there was only so much I could do...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't even know if I still like being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's my fault...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was supposed to give others hope, but instead I did the exact opposite.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I stole your love of being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Momoi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No... Please, Shizuku. You're a true idol.
You're not like me, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't just stand by and watch this happen!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Momoi! Where are you going?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll bet she went to the Cheerful*Days theater.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!
